BiblicalUsage: This word is the rising itself, a resurgence from death, and it occurs once, after the death of Jesus. The graves open, the bodies of saints who slept arise, and they go into the holy city and appear to many. One verse holds a whole resurrection, a sign that His death broke death's hold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the saints rising at His death was a sign of what His rising would finish, because His death opened graves that stayed open.
